name: 一人公司 OS
description: 一人公司操作系统的核心插件外壳。在既有外壳、卡片协议、Magpie 网关与监控（opc-datad、成本熔断）、文件面板笔记 v1（编辑、问 Agent、批注、锁定）、卡片墙与 Bases 子集查询引擎、D5a 任务字段、工作流和卡住阶梯，以及 Paseo 安装路径修复之上，加上 D5b：opc-intake 接单引擎（默认观察模式）、工单阶段和 GitHub 端口。packages/intake-core 来自上游 6337fc8。不自动合并 PR。这份 registry 把安装提交钉到 f436b51dc9f1902da204de0d9a9013ed27ebe287。

readme: opc-core is the shell of opc-os. On top of the existing shell, the card protocol, Magpie gateway monitoring (opc-datad and a cost circuit breaker), file-panel notes v1 (edit, ask the Agent, annotations, and lock), the card wall and a Bases subset query engine, the D5a task fields, workflows, and stuck-escalation ladder, and the Paseo install-path fix, this pin adds D5b: the opc-intake engine (observe mode by default), ticket stages, and a GitHub port. packages/intake-core comes from upstream 6337fc8. It does not merge pull requests automatically. This registry record pins the install commit to f436b51dc9f1902da204de0d9a9013ed27ebe287. Magpie source is still not in this repository.
